name: logseq-plugin-block-to-page-db
description: Turn a block into a page with Logseq DB graph support.
author: EINDEX

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check src/block-to-page.mjs && npm test
scripts.build:release: rm -rf release && mkdir -p release/stage && cp -R README.md LICENSE package.json icon.svg index.html main.js src vendor assets release/stage/ && (cd release/stage && zip -r ../logseq-block-to-page-db.zip README.md LICENSE package.json icon.svg index.html main.js src vendor assets) && npm run check:release
scripts.check:release: unzip -Z1 release/logseq-block-to-page-db.zip > release/zip-entries.txt && grep -Fxq package.json release/zip-entries.txt && grep -Fxq index.html release/zip-entries.txt && grep -Fxq main.js release/zip-entries.txt && node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');const data=cp.execFileSync('unzip',['-p','release/logseq-block-to-page-db.zip','package.json'],{encoding:'utf8'});if(JSON.parse(data).main !== 'index.html') process.exit(1);"
